nodes.label: Onboarding Wizard (3-step study space setup)
nodes.rationale: Three client-side steps (board, class, subjects+goal) with shake animation on missing required radio; personalizes all content filtering to the student's board/class. Skippable via 'Skip for now' so onboarding never blocks access.

edges.source_location: both are built on the same board/class/subject taxonomy: onboarding captures the student's scope, question bank's filter bar applies the same dimensions
